title: Genetic engineering to initiate tumorigenesis in cerebral organoids
protocol: Reconstitute hESC medium by mixing 400 ml of DMEM/F12 with 100 ml of KOSR, 15 ml of FBS, 5 ml of GlutaMAX, 5 ml of MEM-NEAA, and 3.5 µl of 2-ME.
Sterile-filter the hESC medium using a 22 µm filter bottle.
Store the hESC medium at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks after preparation.
Reconstitute NI medium by mixing 500 ml of DMEM/F12 with 5 ml of N2 supplement, 5 ml of GlutaMAX, 5 ml of MEM-NEAA, and 500 µl of Heparin solution.
Sterile-filter the NI medium using a 22 µm filter bottle.
Store the NI medium at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks after preparation.

Reconstitute differentiation medium by mixing 250 ml of DMEM/F12 with 250 ml of Neurobasal, 2.5 ml of N2 supplement, 5 ml of B27, 125 µl of Insulin, 175 µl of a 1:100 solution of 2-ME in DMEM/F12, 5 ml of GlutaMAX, 2.5 ml of MEM-NEAA, and 5 ml of P/S solution.
Sterile-filter the differentiation medium using a 22 µm filter bottle.
Store the differentiation medium at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks after preparation.
Reconstitute FGF2/bFGF stock solution by mixing 50 µg of FGF2/bFGF with 5 ml PBS +0.1% BSA.
Aliquot the FGF2/bFGF stock solution into 50 or 100 µl aliquots and store at -20 °C for up to 1 year.
Prepare heparin stock solution by mixing Heparin in PBS.
Store the heparin stock solution at -20 °C for up to 1 year.
Reconstitute RI stock solution by mixing 5 mg of RI with 2.96 ml of H2O.
Aliquot the RI stock solution into volumes between 0.5-1 ml.
Store aliquots at -20°C.
Prepare a gelatin solution as 0.1% wt/vol in H2O.
For a 500 ml solution, dissolve 0.5 g of Gelatin in H2O at 50°C.
Sterile-filter the gelatin solution with a 22 µm filter bottle.
Store the gelatin solution at 4°C for up to one year.
Prepare a collagenase IV solution as 1 mg/ml in DMEM/F-12 medium.
Sterile-filter the collagenase IV solution with a 22 µm filter.
Aliquot and store the collagenase IV solution at -20°C for up to six months.
Prepare a dispase solution as 0.5 mg/ml in DMEM/F-12 medium.
Sterile-filter the dispase solution with a 22 µm filter.
Aliquot and store the dispase solution at -20°C for up to six months.
Prepare a single cell suspension using hESCs cultured in either feeder-independent or feeder-dependent manner.
Count the cell density using an automated cell counter.
Seed nine thousand live cells per well in 150 µl of hESC medium containing RI and low FGF2/bFGF in a 96-well low-attachment U-bottom cell culture plate.
Exchange the medium with fresh hESC medium without RI and FGF2/bFGF.
Replace the hESC medium with NI medium to induce neural lineage differentiation when EB sizes exceed 500 µm.
Exchange the NI medium every second day for six days to expand neuroectoderm.
Prepare nucleofector solution according to manufacturer’s protocol by mixing 82 μl of solution 1 and 18 μl of supplement 1 for one reaction.

Add up to 5 µg of plasmid cocktail into the nucleofector solution, including 500 ng of transposase expression vector pCAG-SB100X, 1 µg of transposon vector for pCAG-eGFP, and 1 µg of each transposon vectors to express oncogene and/or CRISPR-Cas9 vectors.
Collect about 15 EBs.
Wash the collected EBs with PBS.
Resuspend the washed EBs in nucleofection solution containing plasmid cocktails.
Transfer the resuspended EBs into nucleofection cuvettes using widened pipette tips.
Nucleofect EBs under program A-023 using NucleofectorTM 2b.
Gently add 1 ml of NI medium to EBs in the nucleofection cuvettes.
Pour the EBs with medium into 6-cm dishes containing additional NI medium.
Incubate the dishes in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C overnight.
Transfer EBs onto parafilm in 6- or 10-cm petri dish on day 12 or 13.
Carefully remove excess medium from EBs.
Embed EBs into a droplet of matrigel and center them before the matrigel solidifies.
Incubate embedded EBs at 37 °C for 20 min to allow matrigel to solidify.
Add differentiation medium \(-A) onto EBs to wash off the parafilm.
Discard the parafilm from the petri dish.
Culture embedded EBs in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C without shaking.
Replace differentiation medium \(-A) with differentiation medium \(+A).
Transfer the dish onto an orbital shaker in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C.
Change medium twice a week with differentiation medium \(+A).
Collect neoplastic cerebral organoids with overgrowth of GFP-positive mutated cells for further analysis.
Exchange differentiation medium \(+A) twice per week for neoplastic cerebral organoid culture.
